forbidden_v1_behaviour: new n-gram Hamming rank effect in V1
sample n-gram assets treated as V1 authority
full resume/checkpoint solving promised as V1
absolute paths in public artifact manifests
explicit TORCH request silently falls back to NumPy
fixed scheduled-stream values treated as text characters
dynamic stop reasons left outside the V1 stop schema

huge_ngram_assets.allowed_only_if: not required as V1 runtime artifacts

new_ngram_hamming_scoring.allowed_only_if: production_rank_effect is none and integration mode is report_only_no_rank_effect

artifact_agreement.rule: reviewable run artifacts must be listed with stable relative paths and explicit kind

optional_torch_runtime.rule: Torch is a supported optional V1 scorer runtime; normal CI may skip runtime tests, but explicit TORCH requests must use Torch or raise a clear error

release_full_proof_gate.rule: manual full-proof workflow installs full_v1, runs complete pytest, and runs all active V1 tutorials on Python 3.11 for Windows and Ubuntu; the automatic push gate uses ci_light

scheduled_stream_lookup.rule: canonical V1 cipher family for scheduled stream/key lookup work; stream values, schedules, degeneracy, and anchors must be explicit

scorer_capability_status.rule: requested/effective lane state must be typed and reportable through public scorer and backend/facade boundaries

span_hamming.rule: requested span-Hamming must run, block, or use explicit reported fallback; it must not silently disappear

stop_reason_schema.rule: solver stop reasons are reported through stable V1 categories, including emitted aliases and dynamic budget families

two_period_cribs.rule: specialised additive two-period scheduled_stream_lookup solver using explicit complete-word crib evidence, deterministic staged search and complete-union retention; it rejects unsupported options rather than silently dropping them

typed_builder_config_boundary.rule: public builders require typed CipherConfig and ScoringConfig objects; compatibility shims must not bypass the boundary
